intro.text: A young nobleman of Luthadel, brother of Callins Geffenry, who had once danced with Valette Renoux.

items.text: Ardous and his brother Callins were killed in reprisal for the murder of Charrs Entrone, although neither had any part in it.
When the killings came up in conversation, Valette mentioned that she had danced with Ardous at a ball. Milen Davenpleu asked whether he had been a good dancer, and Tyden answered with a grim pun.
